retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered urban portrait featuring a central figure with money, a secondary ghosted portrait, and heavy distressed block lettering.
triggerTerms: urban mixtape cover with distressed text
luxury lifestyle album art with smoke and gold accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex composition featuring a central woman with pink hair holding a fan of cash, flanked by a larger, semi-transparent portrait on the right. The scene is set inside a luxury vehicle with quilted leather, unified by warm golden lighting, smoke overlays, and a large, textured title at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure holding cash as the primary focal point
Secondary ghosted portrait creating depth and narrative
Heavy distressed typography anchoring the bottom third
Warm golden light and smoke textures unifying disparate elements
coreInvariants: Warm, desaturated color palette with golden highlights
Distressed, cracked texture applied to the main title
Double exposure effect with varying opacities

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure at medium scale; secondary portrait at large scale occupying the right half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured 'BOTH WAYS' title at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the cash fan, moves to the ghosted face on the right, then down to the bold title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures, smoke, and overlapping subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and blacks in the background and leather.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Peach and pink tones in the hair and title texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for light flares and feathers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high contrast between deep shadows and bright golden highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, thick strokes with minimal counters
Tight kerning creating a solid block effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature a heavy 'cracked earth' or 'peeling paint' texture overlay
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured display font paired with a clean, widely spaced secondary sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky, heavy skeleton for the display text.
Clean geometric sans for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a double exposure urban portrait of a woman with pink hair holding cash in a luxury car, with smoke and golden light flares, leaving the bottom third clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked, extra-bold sans-serif text with a cracked orange texture in the bottom center, and a smaller white spaced-out name below it.

verificationChecks: Is the main title heavily textured and cracked?
Are there golden light flares and smoke effects?
Is the color palette warm and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Color of the hair and title texture
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the money
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text texture looks like physical cracking.
Ensure the smoke doesn't obscure the main facial features.
Verify the golden feathers have a soft glow.
Confirm the parental advisory label is in the bottom right corner.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Double Exposure + Distressed Block Typography + Warm Smoke Overlay
